questions.contextText:
Comprehension Passage – I (Questions 41 – 45): Read the following passage carefully and
answer the questions that follow.
Seed banks—repositories that preserve seeds of diverse crop varieties and wild plant species under
controlled low temperatures and humidity—serve as critical insurance against agricultural
biodiversity loss. Over the past century, industrial agriculture's reliance on a narrow set of high-
yielding monocultures has eroded genetic diversity, leaving food systems vulnerable to emerging
plant pathogens, pests, and climatic extremes. Ex situ conservation in seed banks safeguards
heirloom cultivars and wild crop relatives that harbour traits such as drought tolerance, salinity
resistance, and disease immunity. However, stored seeds are not immortal; they require periodic
germination testing, regeneration, and thorough documentation to prevent genetic drift or loss of
viability, alongside in situ conservation that allows crops to evolve dynamically with local farmers.
questions.questionText: According to the passage, why have modern food systems become vulnerable to pests, diseases, and extreme weather?
options: Because seed banks prohibit farmers from cultivating traditional crops
Because industrial agriculture has relied on a narrow range of monocultures, eroding genetic diversity
Because wild crop relatives cannot survive in controlled low-temperature storage
Because drought tolerance is absent in all heirloom plant varieties

ମାଧ୍ୟମ ଭାବେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରିଆସିଛି । ପାରସ୍ପରିକ ସହଯୋଗ, ସମାନତା ଏବଂ ସାମୂହିକ ସ୍ୱାର୍ଥ ରକ୍ଷା ହେଉଛି ସମବାୟ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥାର ମୂଳ
ଭିତ୍ତି । କୃଷି ଋଣ ଯୋଗାଣ, ସାର ଓ ବିହନ ବଣ୍ଟନ, ଦୁଗ୍ଧ ଉତ୍ପାଦନ ଏବଂ ହସ୍ତତନ୍ତ ବିକ୍ରୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରରେ ସମବାୟ ସମିତିଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ
ଭୂମିକା ଗ୍ରହଣ କରୁଛନ୍ତି । ତେବେ ପରିଚାଳନାଗତ ଦୁର୍ବଳତା, ରାଜନୈତିକ ହସ୍ତକ୍ଷେପ ଏବଂ ସଦସ୍ୟମାନଙ୍କ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ସଚେତନତାର
ଅଭାବ ସମବାୟ ସଂସ୍ଥାଗୁଡ଼ିକର ଅଗ୍ରଗତିରେ ବାଧା ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରୁଛି । ତେଣୁ ପେସାଦାର ପରିଚାଳନା, ସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛତା ଏବଂ ଡିଜିଟାଲ
ଆଧୁନିକୀକରଣ ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ସମବାୟ ଆନ୍ଦୋଳନକୁ ଅଧିକ ସକ୍ରିୟ ଓ ବିଶ୍ୱସନୀୟ କରିବା ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ।
